1.why: Source P1: up and right toward trees, about one rope length, ends at a belay nook with a small anchor tree.
1.text: Belay from a small tree in a nook about a rope length up from the notch, working rightward along the ledges.

2.why: Source P2: roped scramble to a sandy spot near the Shark Fin, #2/#3 cams behind a flake; second source: ledge at base of the fin.
2.text: Belay on a sandy stance beside the foot of the Shark Fin, with cams placed behind a flake.
